messages:
jamie: kicking off deploy of dialog-model-v2 to prod in ~10m. plan is a gradual feature-flag ramp for llm_route_v2. will pin model to v2.3.0 before traffic shift. watching latency and 5xx closely.

deploy-bot: queued and scheduled for 2026-03-21T10:00Z. auto-rollback policy: 5xx>1% over 5m or p95 spike >200ms. will post checkpoints.

priya: quick suggestion — start at 0.5% for first 5m, then 2% for next 10m, 10% for 15m, 50% 10m, then 100%. lower initial canary reduces noise. :+1:

marc: also recommend routing that initial canary to internal-beta cohort only (cohort id: internal-beta) so external users unaffected. set canary rate cap to 20 rps.

lena: FYI last model switch we saw KV-cache cold misses that caused brief 503s at N=1024 seq. add a kv-cache warmup step after pin but before broad ramp.

alex: rollback ops ready. quick commands if we need immediate rollback:
```
/deploybot toggle --flag llm_route_v2 --off --reason "rollback-latency-spike"
/deploybot pin model dialog-model --version v2.2.8
```

priya: ops-bot please create a temporary ramp dashboard (p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, token-cost deltas, error types). tag alerts to #eng-oncall and SRE oncall.

ops-bot: dashboard created -> https://console.internal/dashboards/dialog-model-ramp (placeholder). alert rules: 5xx_rate>0.5% OR p95>baseline+150ms -> page SRE.

deploy-bot: canary applied at 0.5% (internal-beta) at 10:05Z. will report metrics in 5m checkpoint.

jamie: I'll monitor SLOs and keep my phone close. ping me for immediate rollback. :eyes:

marc: if 5xx jumps or p95 > 200ms above baseline, revert to v2.2.8 and disable llm_route_v2. agreed?

lena: warmup sequence executed, KV cache populated, no missing keys observed on canary hosts.

deploy-bot: canary advanced to 10% at 10:20Z (still internal cohort + a small external slice). no anomalies so far. proceeding to 50% over next 10m.

jamie: hold on final 50->100 step for 5m sanity check.

alex: release-note reminder: mention subtle brevity behaviour change, include rollout notes and pin details. I can draft the blurb.

ops-bot: final check OK, no alert fires. ready for 100% ongo.

jamie: moving to 100% now. flag llm_route_v2 at 100% and leaving model pinned to v2.3.0 for 30m. schedule post-rollout smoke check. :tada:

marc: thumbs up. if any regression after 30m, escalate rollback per commands above.

jamie: done — flag at 100%. will post short follow-up with perf numbers in ~30m. thanks everyone.
